title: Control catalogue (v1)
description: The controls of one standard edition, as a hierarchy, with which ones have an audit skill. Ships with plugin releases so the dashboard can show planned controls and roll up large standards without hand-maintained lists. Titles are short headings only — never standard text.

coverage.description: 'complete' = every control of the edition is listed; 'partial' = only some; 'sample' = test data, not for production.

parent.description: Parent control id, or null for a top-level group.

auditable.description: True for leaf controls an audit can assess (groups are false).

skill.description: plugin:skill that assesses this control. Absent = planned.
